title: The Rise of LLMJacking: How Threat Actors Monetize Compromised Cloud and Model Resources
content: Threat actors are hijacking enterprise access to Large Language Models through a tactic called LLMJacking, impacting organizations across North America, South America, and Asia Pacific in financial services, retail, technology, and transportation sectors. Unlike cryptojacking's gradual consumption, LLMJacking generates massive spikes in fraudulent cloud charges, with incidents exceeding $100,000... This pulse includes 3 indicators of compromise (IOCs). Targeted industries: Finance, Retail, Technology. Associated malware: Bankshot - S0239, Trojan Manuscript.

title: DarkBlinders: Active Espionage Campaign
content: A sophisticated cyberespionage operation targeting Israel and the Kurdistan Region of Iraq was conducted by DarkBlinders, the threat actor behind the Blinder Tunnel campaign. Active between August and October 2026, the campaign compromised a high-profile Israeli individual associated with the security sector and a government cloud environment in the Kurdistan Region. title: Exploitation Targeting Node-RED, a Tool Embedded in ICS Products
content: On October 30, 2026, exploitation activity was detected targeting CVE-2026-58115, an unauthenticated Node-RED admin API vulnerability. Attackers deployed malicious flows that automatically download and execute Linux bots through three layers of encoding. Targeted industries: Manufacturing, Energy, Healthcare.

title: BITTER Expands Its Arsenal with PapRAT
content: A cyberespionage group known as BITTER has been conducting campaigns targeting South Asian organizations using PowerShell scripts and a custom remote access trojan called PapRAT.
